job.title: Senior Projektmanager SAP Commerce Cloud / CX (m/w/d)

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience building, extending, and integrating large-scale B2B/B2C platforms (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP data pipelines, and database optimization. Proven track record bridging business requirements and technical delivery in agile international teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Projektmanager SAP Commerce Cloud / CX (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: Thomas Biber Deutschland GmbH's commitment to delivering robust digital commerce solutions aligns perfectly with my extensive background in enterprise CX platforms. Bringing over 5 years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud expertise across global projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bridge business strategy and technical execution to drive complex implementations.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Acted in a techno-functional capacity with business stakeholders at Rockwell Automation to analyse requirements, write user stories, and translate complex business needs into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, resolving critical integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: API & Platform Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefronts, engineering API migrations for customer account structures to improve system stability.

bullets.label: Agile Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements directly with product owners and international business teams, mapping processes and supporting user acceptance testing.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP Commerce expertise adds value to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Projektmanager SAP Commerce Cloud / CX (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Thomas Biber Deutschland GmbH steht für erstklassige digitale Handelslösungen und exzellentes CX-Management. Mit über 5 Jahren fundierter Praxiserfahrung in der Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von SAP Commerce Cloud Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefgehendes technisches und funktionales Know-how mit, um komplexe E-Commerce-Projekte erfolgreich zu steuern.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Steuerung der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT bei Rockwell Automation: Analyse von Geschäftsanforderungen, Erstellung von User Stories und Übersetzung in skalierbare SAP Commerce Lösungen.

bullets.label: Komplexe Systemintegrationen
bullets.text: Konzeption und Optimierung von PIM-zu-Hybris Datenpipelines über Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub sowie Behebung von Integrationsengpässen zwischen SAP ERP und MDM.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung & Migration
bullets.text: Entwicklung von OCC REST Web Services für Headless-Architekturen sowie Durchführung von API-Migrationen für Kundenkontostrukturen zur Steigerung der Systemstabilität.

bullets.label: Stakeholder-Management
bullets.text: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern und internationalen Teams bei Shell und Rockwell Automation zur Anforderungsanalyse, Prozessabbildung und Begleitung von Abnahmetests.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe und verfüge über eine unbeschränkte deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung stehe. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: Thomas Biber Deutschland GmbH's reputation for delivering sophisticated enterprise CX and SAP Commerce solutions makes it an ideal environment for my techno-functional expertise. Having driven complex integrations and stakeholder alignment for global platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to apply my skills to help your team execute high-impact e-commerce projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience and strong techno-functional skills to drive enterprise projects at Thomas Biber Deutschland GmbH.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise in integrations and stakeholder management. I would love to discuss how I can contribute to Thomas Biber Deutschland GmbH.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Projektmanager SAP Commerce Cloud / CX - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Projektmanager SAP Commerce Cloud / CX position at Thomas Biber Deutschland GmbH.

With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms, complex integrations, and techno-functional solutions for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to support your team.

I look forward to discussing my application in an interview.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
